steps.hints: ❓ Did you use the documentation for help with updating the Enemy sprite movement and variable image consistency?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja:

❓ Which function variable should be used to access the Enemy sprite’s location when it overlaps a wall tile?


Solution:

location should be replaced with sprite in the 3 tilemapLocation() functions inside the onHitWall Enemy sprite event.


Ask the ninja:

❓ What color animation should the Enemy sprite display, once the a Projectile sprite overlaps a blue crab image? When it overlaps a green crab image?


Solution:

The animation assets used in the 2 runImageAnimation functions inside the Projectile/Enemy onOverlap event should be swapped, so that they match the new color of the Enemy sprite.


Ask the ninja:

❓ How might the code documentation tool be used to help code the arguments passed to the createTextSprite functions? 


Solution:

2 createTextSprite function calls should be added to the createScreenText function. 7 arguments should be passed in each function call. In the first parameter, the convertToText function should be used to convert the lives and money number variables to strings that can be displayed on screen. In the last parameter, the livesIcon and moneyIcon image assets should be used to display the variables on screen.
steps.instructions:
Fix the bugs in the code to create a working project!


When an Enemy sprite hits a wall, its velocity should update based on the tile at the overlap location.


When Projectile sprites overlap Enemy sprites, the Enemy sprite’s animation should match the color that its image changes to.


After the user selects a level, the values of the lives and money variables should appear on the game screen, with corresponding icon images. 


Use the functions in the code menu and the code completion tool to create a working version of this project!
